verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature for setting up automations that run on their own in the background. Plugins run "when invoked by the user" and the Figma agent is used interactively. Webhooks, the REST API for CI/CD and the MCP server are developer building blocks that external tools could use to build automation, not a product-native background automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
